scope: Startup-only conf-file and conf-script. Necessary conf-dir integration is regression-only; physical routers are untouched. C NULL second -C is recorded as a dedicated reference defect, not a blanket acceptance exception.

checklist.boundary: First CLI -C is deferred until argument traversal ends; subsequent files/includes/scripts execute in place, and real DNS state proves ordering.
Long optional and short required argument forms, attached values, empty first selection and second empty selection; isolate the latter NULL-path C defect with an exact-image minimal reproduction.
Default /etc/dnsmasq.conf missing is optional; explicit missing files, dangling links, unreadable files, directories and read/open failures preserve exit code and diagnostic location.
Config conf-file empty is a no-op; stdin - is read only once, including nested/repeated references, and emitted records become queryable.
Device/inode deduplication precedes parsing: repeated pathname, hardlink, symlink, recursive pair and cross file/script references execute only once.
Relative includes resolve against process cwd rather than includer directory; nested errors identify the actual source and line, with lexing/failure order retained.
Necessary conf-dir integration only: byte order, suffix/backup filtering, shared inode dedup and nested include failure; conf-dir itself is already closed.
CLI/file duplicate and override semantics, CRLF/comments/quoted file names/final unterminated line, and --test versus actual UDP/TCP DNS results compare strictly.
Execute trusted shell command through /bin/sh; empty directive is no-op, CLI and file input apply output at their source position.
Command string is statted before execution: literal executable paths and hardlinks share inode dedup, commands with arguments/pipelines retain their own execution count.
Generated config has ordinary lexing/include semantics; parser failures report in output from COMMAND, nested file/script errors preserve innermost source.
Successful output changes real UDP/TCP DNS state. Empty stdout and stderr are distinct; nonzero exits, signal termination and missing commands preserve raw wait status plus 10 and exact stderr.
Slow and chunked output is consumed before listener startup, including last unterminated line; no new script execution enters the live poll owner.
Parse-error and normal-exit descendant boundaries: capture parent/child/grandchild completion, reparenting, broken stdout pipe and marker side effects before fixture cleanup.
Pipelines, inherited stdin and nested script output are real shell executions; preserve actual process identity and causality, do not replace scripts with prerecorded output.
Every run records listener responsiveness or absence, stdout/stderr, process tree and raw wait statuses; reap fixture-owned descendants and verify no PID/listener residue.

scenarios.reference_defect: NULL second -C reaches strcmp(NULL, "-") in option.c:5654; this C-only minimum must never become a blanket exception

slow.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh
echo $$ > /m2/input/pids/slow
echo start > /m2/input/effects/start
printf 'host-record=slow.input,'
sleep 1
printf '192.0.2.21\n'
echo done > /m2/input/effects/done

outer.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh
echo $$ > /m2/input/pids/outer
/m2/input/child.sh &
sleep 1
printf 'unknown-config-option\n'
wait
echo outer > /m2/input/effects/outer

pipe.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh
echo $$ > /m2/input/pids/pipe
trap 'echo pipe > /m2/input/effects/pipe; exit 0' PIPE
printf 'unknown-config-option\n'
sleep 1
printf 'host-record=late.input,192.0.2.56\n'
echo missed > /m2/input/effects/missed

calibration_notes: c-baseline-01 retained: exact BusyBox sleep rejects fractional .4; slow-script fixture changed to integer 1 second, not a product mismatch.

Exact-image strace: dnsmasq.c ignores SIGPIPE before read_opts(); popen shell retains SIG_IGN, so its attempted PIPE trap remains ignored and the post-write missed marker is emitted after parse-error parent exit. Rust Command must restore SIG_IGN in pre_exec.
